name: DM Quick Reference
gm_notes:
NPC OGAS SUMMARY:
Corvinus: Objective=consulship, Goal=possess spear, Agenda=control escort, Secret=Brutus owns his gambling debts
Cassia: Objective=prevent divine catastrophe, Goal=destroy spear, Agenda=guide party without forcing them, Secret=she is Mars's daughter; she can feel the spear
Varro: Objective=protect soldiers, Goal=keep party alive, Agenda=quietly arm trusted men near spear, Secret=knows more about Corvinus's debts than he lets on
Lucius: Objective=complete Brutus's commission, Goal=destroy spear, Agenda=look legitimate while doing it, Secret=still receiving raven orders to kill Cassia
Vercingetorix: Objective=protect his tribe, Goal=reclaim sacred grove, Agenda=ally with party against Corvinus, Secret=Thusnelda is his sister; he sent her to the fort deliberately
Brutus: Objective=overthrow Marcus Aurelius, Goal=prevent Mars from being appeased so Rome burns on his schedule, Agenda=activate sleeper agents and order arson, Secret=plans to sacrifice Vindolanda if the fort defies him
Thusnelda: Objective=seal spear permanently, Goal=return it to grove, Agenda=help party reach grove, Secret=carries the sealing rite in her memory; she is the key

CORRUPTION: 0=none, 1=disturbing dreams, 2=DisAdv WIS saves, 3=DC12 WIS to retreat, 4=DC14 WIS vs attacking nearest at half HP, 5=Mars-driven NPC
Gain: touch spear (1), fail WIS save (1), sleep near spear 3 nights (1)
Lose: Lemuria observance + DC14 WIS (-1), grove ritual (→0)

SPEAR: +2 weapon, 1d8+1d8 necrotic. Touch without attunement: DC10 WIS or Frightened 1 min. Cannot be destroyed by mortal means. Seal only at sacred grove.
